title: Replit Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Replit is a capable full dev environment with a real agent, but it falls short on pricing predictability, non-technical editing, and native billing. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform.
body_markdown: Blink. It covers Replit's three biggest gaps natively, flat pricing instead of effort-based surprises, a Visual Editor instead of chat-only editing, and native Stripe subscription billing instead of wiring it by hand, and it's a more complete platform overall: native mobile apps, a customer-facing AI gateway, and built-in growth tooling are all things Replit doesn't offer at any tier. More options are listed in our[Replit alternatives](https://blink.new/blog/replit-alternatives) roundup.
